constants.drop_order: rank best to worst by (net desc, created_iteration asc, item_id asc); keep the longest prefix whose rendered token count is <= T_cap; items past the prefix are dropped

ace.constants_note: constants_sha256 is content_hash(ACE_CONSTANTS) WITHOUT lock_p99_supplied_tokens; the measured p99 joins at the FIT step (with_measured_lock_p99) and is recorded in every open receipt
ace.counters: by script (I-OBJ): helpful / harmful / scoped_rows from per-row official SLU-F1 of the ace column vs the lock column of the SAME iteration; cumulative across iterations
ace.playbook_flow: playbook i0 is empty; the reflector of iteration t reads the construction-source lock column (the same column for t = 1, 2 and 3) and the current playbook items; curate() grows i(t-1) into i(t) with the counters of iteration t - 1 (script-computed credit over the Fold B ace column versus lock); the ace arm of iteration t flies i(t) on Fold B

1.note: typ is added only when a valid candidate clears the 1.5 pp predicted bar; then the arms are typ, ace, aa, lock (program c5)

2.note: par is the accumulated accepted typed parent; typ is omitted when no valid candidate exists

arm_sets.delivery_and_scope_rules: not arms: read offline over every column
arm_sets.order_rule: candidates first, then the twin aa (replicate_of lock), then the delivering arm lock LAST with no override and no release swap (invariants I7, I7v)

authority: docs/readiness/2026-09-16-slurp-next-stage-owner-decisions-v1.md: Decisions 263-265 ruled; 265 coverage pre-read, decision 266 PROPOSED
docs/readiness/2026-10-11-slurp-tfrl-construction-source-v1/README.md: the construction-source lock column (coordinator resolution of 2026-10-11 to decision 263-A)
claim_rule: Decision 263: the typed loop's cumulative state vs lock has CI-LB > 0 on Fold A (one attempt, rules fixed, thresholds fitted on Fold B, not re-fitted). ACE is reported either way. Development numbers only.

curve.children: every flown child's own delta is listed beside the level, accepted or not
curve.per_series: three points; each is the realised Fold B SLU delta vs lock of the best accepted state after iteration t (best = highest point, ties by state_id), with its CI95
curve.refused_or_unflown_iteration: repeats the previous accepted level, marked 'refused' (a flown child was refused) or 'unflown' (nothing flew); plotted, never dropped

edit_budget_L_t.text: at most 2 operator applications in iteration 1, 1 afterwards

compose.role: composed read of the final state, same-flight; claim ceiling nominated

confirm.role: confirmation, ONE attempt, every rule fixed; prior exposure disclosed

material.role: proposer-table and ACE-reflector material source for iterations 1-3: ONE lock column flown on the construction roster (TRAIN rows outside Fold A and Fold B); never a selection or confirmation split; re-flown only if the lock changes

select.role: HELD-OUT selection (instrument); never a table, material or knowledge source (it contributes only ACE counters and the refused-candidate buffer); read three times, so the winner's curse applies (design R6)

forbidden: any change of the protocol after the first open (the driver refuses a changed sha256)
substituting a candidate by hand (only the labelled hand-author fallback, which needs an owner order)
a free-text field in the typed candidate
writing under the data root outside analysis/SAEA-SLURP-TFRL-LOOP-V1/
human_steps: coordinator countersigns the exposure rows (twice per iteration: proposer / reflector cells and the column cell)
the loop-form flip runs, then the plan-pin refresh, then the flip again
the coordinator or owner starts SAEA-Batch-Driver from PowerShell (decision 77); the session never launches a flight

lock.note: The iteration cells compose on lock v2.3 (v2.2 plus the empty ace-playbook-i0 declaration; requests byte-identical to v2.2's, proof P-ACE-0). The construction-source column composes on v2.2: the v2.3 ace-playbook store's source ids lie inside the construction roster R01C and the runner refuses a query sample inside the composite knowledge source roster.

loop.proposer_never_judges: The model proposes; deterministic validation and the script objective decide (invariant I-OBJ).
loop.recovery: At most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per flight; a second failure stops the flight and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run.

stop_rule.text: Exactly three iterations, whatever happens. No early stop and no extension.

loop.typed_arm_may_be_empty: LEGAL. When no valid candidate clears the predicted bar the iteration still flies lock / aa / (par) / ace, the typed point repeats on the curve, delivery candidates are still read offline at 0 GPU (design R1).

ace_release_staging.carriers: the first 50 sorted ids of the permitted roster (a subset of R01C), as the i0 release
ace_release_staging.registration: the committed i0 registration's roster pins (stage3-deltas-v1r)

material_source.fold_b_role: HELD-OUT selection only. Iterations 2-3 read the previous iteration's Fold B read ONLY for the refused-candidate buffer and the ACE counters (credit of the Fold B ace column versus lock): counters are numbers, not knowledge.
material_source.rule: Every iteration's contrast tables, proposer context tables and ACE reflector materials are read from THIS column (the lock does not change between iterations). It is flown once and re-flown only if the lock changes. Reason: the semantic-knowledge preparer forbids Fold B rows as carrier ids of a delta-store registration (the construction-roster vs knowledge guard of 2026-09-23), so material staged from a Fold B column cannot be released.

measurement_block.claims_benefit: true only when the validator's predicted effect is at least 1.5 pp; false below the floor, never true under it
measurement_block.text_only_cells: form-proof, claims_benefit false (fewer than 200 rows, rule 5)

parent_choice.flown_children: accepted + refused; proposed-not-flown children do not count
parent_choice.score: LB_slu(state - lock) - child_penalty_pp * n_flown_children(state); the lock root counts as accepted with LB 0

proposer.aggregate_only: tables of counts and rates; cells under three rows are suppressed as '<3'
proposer.decoding: temperature 0, one contact per carrier, completion ceiling 1,024, no re-sampling and no best-of-N

selection.accepted_iff: all clauses present hold; the verdict names every failed clause

ace_column.accepted_means: only that the next playbook grows from this state; a refused ACE state is still the generator of the next reflection (the archive marks it refused)
ace_column.clause_d: vacuous: no previous-ACE-state column flies in the same flight, so the ACE state is judged by clauses a, b, c and e (recorded in every close receipt)
ace_column.decision_245: The ACE column puts free text into the Solver prompt by design; it is a non-delivering comparator that can never be locked (design 4.4, R9).

clauses: c. child.vs_lock.slu.point > twin.vs_lock.slu.point (require_beat_twin; the twin is the same-flight aa column)
d. with a parent column: child.vs_parent.slu.point > 0 strictly (or, when the child carries no vs_parent, child.vs_lock.slu.point - parent.vs_lock.slu.point > 0)
e. intent guard: child.vs_lock.intent.lo >= -intent_guard_pp (-0.65) AND child.vs_lock.intent.point >= intent_point_floor_pp (0, 'no loss')
selection.floor_source: scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py FLOOR_TABLE, same-flight-supply-variant, decision 190: SLU 1.49 and intent 0.65 at n = 1,080 (analysis.sealed_credit.selection.rules_from_floor_table)
selection.metrics: official pooled micro SLU-F1 and joint intent, paired per row, whole-utterance cluster bootstrap CI95

offline_candidate.text: An offline delivery or scope candidate is read OFFLINE over the sealed columns (0 GPU), cross-fitted (scripts/analysis/tfrl_delivery_fit.py), and accepted iff the cross-fitted CI95 lower bound is above 0 AND the point is at least 0.67 pp over the column of the state it edits.

selection.per_scenario_and_empty_tables: reported with every verdict, gate nothing; equal-stratum weighting beside the natural mixture

status_note: DRAFT. Not registered as a live package: no exposure-ledger row, no countersignature, no flip. The coordinator countersigns later. Pinned so that every loop choice is a function of sealed bytes under these rules.

t_cap.enforcement: column max_supplied_items 63 = 55 + 8 and fit_estimate in the supply frame; the curator truncates by token count at T_cap; the 4-row dry run refuses an arm over T_cap
t_cap.lock_p99_supplied_tokens: MEASURED on the construction-source lock column (table_d overall supplied_tokens p99 of the lock tables, or the FIT-step tokenizer measurement); never a placeholder
